obligations.condition: A fresh pending credential of the target completes the phone second factor with the test number's fixed code before any revocation; the ID token names the target through its claims and a derived lookup.
A fresh pending credential of the control completes the phone second factor before any revocation.

The pending credential issued before the validSince update is presented to mfaSignIn:start after the update and its readback. Accepted and refused are both valid observations; the row is always executed.

If start was accepted, the same held credential is finalized with the fixed code. If accepted, the ID token's auth_time is compared with the set validSince and the identity is confirmed by claims and lookup; if refused, the later held rows are skipped.
If finalize was accepted, accounts:lookup with the returned ID token names the target; executed exactly when finalize was accepted.
If finalize was accepted, the returned refresh token is redeemed and the derived ID token names the target; executed exactly when finalize was accepted.
After the held observation, a fresh sign-in of the target completes the second factor, bounding the run against a broken account.
After the held observation, a fresh sign-in of the unaffected control completes the second factor, bounding the run against an environment-wide failure.

limitations: URLs were read during design; no new frozen full-body source snapshot or completed page-review claim is made by this mapping.

The sources define the operations and the validSince semantics for refresh tokens; none of them states whether an MFA pending credential issued before a validSince update remains usable. The observation, not the sources, answers that for the recorded conditions.

Explicit validSince update only: no password change, no tenant, no blocking function, phone MFA with test phone numbers, one run. The interval between the update and the retry was not measured, and the refusal of a pre-update refresh token was not checked as a control.

The oracle project's MFA, phone sign-in and SMS region configuration were changed for the run and restored; the restore readback and whole-configuration digest comparison are part of the receipt, not a claim about production defaults.
No execution approval, independent signature verification, SDK checkRevoked, Rules or expiry claim follows from this mapping.
